---
title: Blog
listing:
  id: posts
  type: metadata
  contents: "*.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
---

The listing is declared above with `type: metadata`: it resolves the
posts and publishes them at `meta.listings.posts`, and renders nothing.
The two cells below build the markup.

## Cards

```{lmd}
local cards = meta.listings.posts.items:map(function(it)
  return {=:
::: {.card}
### `{lmd} pandoc.Link(it.title, it.path)`

`{lmd} it.date` · `{lmd} it.author or "anonymous"` ·
`{lmd} tostring(#it.categories)` categories ·
`{lmd} it["description-source"]` description

`{lmd} it.description`
:::
:=}
end)
return pandoc.Div(cards, pandoc.Attr("lmd-posts"))
```

## By year

```{lmd}
local by_year, years = {}, {}
for _, it in ipairs(meta.listings.posts.items) do
  local y = it["date-iso"]:sub(1, 4)
  if not by_year[y] then
    by_year[y] = {}
    years[#years + 1] = y
  end
  table.insert(by_year[y], it)
end
table.sort(years, function(a, b) return a > b end)

local out = pandoc.Blocks({})
for _, y in ipairs(years) do
  out:extend({=:
### `{lmd} y`
:=})
  -- One list per year: each item is a `Blocks` fragment, which is
  -- what `pandoc.BulletList` takes for a list item.
  local entries = pandoc.List(by_year[y]):map(function(it)
    return {=: `{lmd} pandoc.Link(it.title, it.path)` (`{lmd} it.date`) :=}
  end)
  out:insert(pandoc.BulletList(entries))
end
return pandoc.Div(out, pandoc.Attr("lmd-by-year"))
```

There are `{lmd} tostring(#meta.listings.posts.items)` posts in all.
